milestone: V1-05B3 explicit replication request and native authorization service
role: core_review authored the two new request/service modules and four new test files; independent review is owned by pro_review
scope: Immutable generic request table with bounded read-only historical lookup and caller-owned insert-only transactions.

First coordinator adapter accepts only current confirmed native B1 training terminals, matching bounded canonical source configuration, launch execution identity, artifact declaration and artifact metadata.

One explicit request ID maps atomically to one new queued task with unchanged configuration/seed and an audited UNKNOWN-to-QUEUED admission. No source-file append or new task directory is created by admission.
Launch authorization reads the durable mapping and rechecks source, scope, target configuration and current claim. It does not start/commit a transaction or hash large inputs.

Ordinary proposal admission and Pro proposal dedup remain unchanged. The existing private insertion primitive is reused only inside the explicit coordinator transaction; no public skip-dedup option was added.

pre_freeze_fixture_correction.reason: The existing source effect guard may immediately reject a simultaneous same-host acquisition as attempt_effect_lock_unavailable. The original unfrozen fixture incorrectly retried only errors containing the word busy. The frozen fixture allows that exact lock rejection, requires at least one actual winner, then retries the identical request key after both contenders return. Every original unique-task/request/count assertion is preserved; this does not grant lock takeover or generate a new request key.

limits: Source configurations must fit bounded JSON-shaped YAML metadata; unavailable configuration is a refusal to authorize replication, not a scientific invalidity claim.
The request ID is not a capability. Internal launch consumers must use the durable mapping and current source/task/claim checks; a configuration field or historical request read is insufficient.

The control service does not start work. Native slot isolation and before-Popen/final attempt binding are authored and evidenced separately by runtime_evidence; CLI and Pro controls have separate owners.
The same fixed new task retains existing bounded retries after a confirmed failure/NOT_STARTED; successful or unresolved attempts are not new launch permission.
A same-config/seed execution is an explicit repetition, not statistical independence. Artifact occurrences, observations and later analysis retain their own identities and qualification rules.

No large artifact hashing occurs in request or launch authorization. Request-side train/base/config identity hashing is outside the short source effect guard and SQL writer; this is not a hostile same-UID filesystem sandbox.

No holdout data, paid provider, real GPU/CPU workload, measured throughput claim, deployment, commit or push was performed by this agent. Full repository verification and final release closure belong to root.
